title.en: Cost of delay: which project first

concept.hr: tjedan čekanja košta; prvi ide projekt s najvećom vrijednošću tjedno ÷ trajanje
concept.en: every week a project waits loses value; order by value per week ÷ duration

summary.hr: Poredaj tri do pet projekata u redu jednog tima i prati koliko vrijednosti izgube dok čekaju, prema redoslijedu po glasnoći, veličini ili omjeru.
summary.en: Reorder three to five projects in one team's queue and watch the value they lose while waiting, against ordering by loudness, size or the ratio.
